title: Match the production mobile footer to localhost
summary: Apply the existing local footer class and light mobile palette to the production release.

changes.detail: Replace hard-coded bg-neutral-950 text-white with styles.footer. Restore the desktop base colors and mobile light color-scheme. The existing mobile #fafafa background now applies; desktop appearance stays as designed.

validation.name: Source comparison
validation.detail: Confirmed production omitted styles.footer while localhost uses it. Only the two footer files were synchronized.

validation.name: Build and production
validation.detail: TypeScript, production build and live CSS verification pending. Physical mobile browser acceptance remains untested.
